Encoding study smallN 1st analysis notebook. Uses the preprocessed trial
table from `S1dataProcessing.m`. The analyses below are: 1.

# Setup

```{r setup-and-load-data}
library(dplyr)       # data wrangling
library(tidyverse)   # data wrangling + ggplot2
library(nlme)        # frequentist mixed models (Appendix)
library(bayesplot)   # posterior predictive checks
library(tidybayes)   # gather posterior draws from emmeans
library(emmeans)     # estimated marginal means / contrasts
library(patchwork)   # combine ggplot panels
library(loo)         # LOO / WAIC model comparison
library(cmdstanr)    # Stan VM mixture ladder (Section 3)
library(posterior)   # Stan draw summaries
library(circular)    # circular SD for signed colour errors

theme_set(theme_bw())
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
set.seed(1234)  # reproducible bootstrap / Stan seeds

d <- read_csv("S1_smallN_model_ready.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
required_col <- c("ID", "CueType", "Duration", "Session", "RT", "AbsErr", "SignedErr")
missing_col <- setdiff(required_col, names(d))

stopifnot(nrow(d)>0)
if (length(missing_col) > 0){
  stop(
    "Missing columns:",
  paste(missing_col, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
```

```{r prepare-factors}
id_raw <- c(unique(d$ID))
id_pub <- c("P01","P02","P03","P04")
names(id_pub) <- id_raw
participants <- unname(id_pub)

d <- d %>%
  mutate(
    ID = factor(id_pub[as.character(ID)], levels = participants),
    CueType = factor(CueType, levels = c("NR", "R")),
    DurationF = factor(
      Duration,
      levels = c("50ms", "100ms", "150ms", "200ms", "250ms", "300ms", "350ms")
    ),
    #Grouping = factor(Grouping),
    SessionF = factor(Session)
    #SessionPhase = factor(SessionPhase, levels = c("Early", "Middle", "Late")),
    #logRT = log(RT)
  )

d_AQ <- droplevels(filter(d, ID == "P01"))
d_HC <- droplevels(filter(d, ID == "P02"))
d_YILIU <- droplevels(filter(d, ID == "P03"))
d_YDL <- droplevels(filter(d, ID == "P04"))
```

# Descriptive Figures

Four vertically stacked panels (one participant each), shared
encoding-duration axis. **Circular SD:** pooled cell estimate (diamond)
with bootstrap 95% CI; semi-transparent **AbsErr** trial points behind.
**RT:** cell median with bootstrap 95% CI; trial-level RT points behind.

```{r }
# 定义角度制转弧度制函数
deg2rad <- function(deg) deg * pi / 180
# 定义弧度制转角度制函数
rad2deg <- function(rad) rad * 180 / pi

bootstrapCnd <- function(data, colID) {

  pbootn <- 1000
  ibootn <- 5000

  uid <- unique(data$ID)
  idn <- length(uid)

  ncnd <- length(unique(data$Cnd))

  pm <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = pbootn, ncol = ncnd)
  hdi <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ncnd, ncol = 4)

  for (cnd in 1:ncnd) {

    # Randomly select participants for the outer bootstrap
    pidx <- sample.int(idn, pbootn, replace = TRUE)

    for (ii in seq_len(pbootn)) {

      # Extract trials for selected participant × condition
      x <- data[
        data$ID == uid[pidx[ii]] &
          data$Cnd == cnd,
        colID,
        drop = TRUE
      ]

      x <- x[is.finite(x)]
      n <- length(x)

      # Generate all bootstrap indices at once:
      # n rows × ibootn columns
      idx <- matrix(
        sample.int(n, n * ibootn, replace = TRUE),
        nrow = n,
        ncol = ibootn
      )

      # Convert bootstrap indices directly into bootstrap data matrix
      xb <- matrix(
        x[idx],
        nrow = n,
        ncol = ibootn
      )

      if (colID == "RT") {

        # One mean for each of the 5000 bootstrap samples
        boots <- colMeans(xb)

      } else if (colID == "SignedErr") {

        # Convert all bootstrap samples to radians
        xb <- xb * pi / 180

        # Circular SD for all 5000 bootstrap samples simultaneously
        C <- colSums(cos(xb))
        S <- colSums(sin(xb))
        R <- sqrt(C^2 + S^2) / n

        boots <- sqrt(-2 * log(R))
      }

      # Mean across the 5000 inner bootstrap estimates
      pm[ii, cnd] <- mean(boots)
    }

    # 95% shortest bootstrap interval
    width <- floor(0.95 * pbootn)

    d_boot <- sort(pm[, cnd])

    span <- d_boot[(width + 1):pbootn] -
      d_boot[1:(pbootn - width)]

    ix <- which.min(span)

    hdi[cnd, ] <- c(
      d_boot[ix],
      d_boot[ix + width],
      mean(d_boot),
      median(d_boot)
    )
  }

  # Convert circular SD from radians back to degrees
  if (colID == "SignedErr") {
    hdi <- hdi * 180 / pi
  }

  colnames(hdi) <- c("lower", "upper", "mean", "median")

  return(hdi)
}
```
